exposure: antenatal care in a private service
cohort: 1276 women in the immediate postpartum period following inpatient hospital birth of a single, live newborn
finding: The overall CS rate was high (57.5%) and associated with better socioeconomic conditions and primiparity.
mod_finding: This study found that cesarean section rates were high in Brazil, with primiparity being associated with higher cesarean section rates.
